title: GateB3AnnotationOutputRecord
description: Canonical schema for single-item Gate B.3 annotation outputs from student or model annotators.

annotation_id.description: Unique opaque annotation identifier matching ANN_B2_001 through ANN_B2_350.

source_id.description: Unique identifier of the annotator (e.g. STUDENT_R1, MODEL_A, MODEL_B).

source_type.description: Discriminator indicating whether the annotation was produced by student review or an isolated model annotator.

taxonomy_version.description: Intent taxonomy evaluated: T2 (12 classes) or T3 (16 classes).

run_id.description: Identifier of the annotation run or pass.

primary_label.description: Preferred canonical intent label, or null if no single interpretation is defensibly preferred.

acceptable_labels.description: Non-empty set of acceptable canonical intent labels under the evaluated taxonomy.

clarification_required.description: Indicates whether user clarification or slot specification is required.

brief_justification.description: Concise natural language semantic rationale for the classification.

recognized_from_prior_work.description: Prior exposure diagnostic: true/false/unsure for student annotator; not_applicable for model annotators.

active_time_seconds.description: Active annotation time in seconds for student annotator (null for model annotators).

rule_difficulty.description: Subjective guideline application difficulty for student annotator (not_applicable for model annotators).

response_status.description: Quality status of the structured record.
